retrieval: count of distinct shared lowercase ASCII word tokens; descending score, ties original order; include zero-score rows if fewer matches
answer_system: Answer the question using only the supplied memory. If the value is not supplied, answer unknown. Reply with only the requested value.
write_system: Write concise factual notes from this conversation. Preserve names, preferences, corrections, schedules and object owners. One fact per line. Do not answer questions or add new facts.
extracted_chunks: nonempty generated lines, stripped; preserve original order and all content; empty output means empty store
scoring: Unicode casefold; collapse whitespace; strip surrounding ASCII punctuation; whole response must equal the single frozen answer. No semantic/LLM judge.
order: histories in file order; write extraction once per history before answering any question; questions in file order; condition order rotated left by question index modulo four
warmup: one fixed arithmetic prompt, max_new_tokens=1; separate reported setup, no scored pilot questions
selection: No tuning, checkpoint selection or post-result prompt edits. All eligible planned pairs retained; full history over cap is ineligible without truncation.
write_amortization: one write per history per condition, shared over its four questions; total write+all read/answer calls
currency: no API billing; energy/cloud/runtime amortization not measured, do not label total economic cost zero
scope: two authored synthetic histories, eight questions, four types, 32 planned answers. A measured local pilot, not LongMemEval/MemDelta replication or a general memory ranking.
